title: All Foreign Gifts Around Us
description: Tangible gifts given to U.S. federal employees by foreign governments, extracted from Federal Register notices (calendar years 2005-2024).
source: Federal Register: Office of Protocol, Gifts to Federal Employees From Foreign Government Sources

gifts.description: One row per reported gift. Source text is preserved in name_and_title, foreign_donor, disposition_raw, donor_country_raw, and recipient_name_raw; the non-_raw columns hold standardized values.

columns.name_and_title: Recipient's full name and title as printed in the Federal Register notice.
columns.recipient_name: Recipient name, honorifics removed. Resolved from officeholder tenure dates when the source text names no one (see recipient_name_source).
columns.recipient_name_raw: Recipient name exactly as the LLM extracted it, before date-based resolution.
columns.recipient_name_source: "date-resolved" when recipient_name was filled in from tenure dates rather than the source text; blank otherwise.
columns.received: Date the gift was received (yyyy-mm-dd, or a partial yyyy-mm/yyyy); null if unknown. See received_precision.
columns.received_precision: "day", "month", "year", "range" (received is the start of a reported date range), or "unknown".
columns.estimated_value: Estimated value in USD. Null where the source listed a non-numeric value (e.g. "Unknown", "In appraisal process"); ranges (e.g. "1000-1500") resolve to the low end.
columns.disposition: What happened to the gift, standardized to a controlled set of values (e.g. "Transferred to NARA", "Pending Transfer to GSA", "Retained for Official Use").
columns.disposition_raw: Disposition text as printed, before standardization.
columns.foreign_donor: Donor's full name, title, and country as printed in the Federal Register notice.
columns.donor_name: Donor name, honorifics removed. Blank when the recipient is an anonymous agency employee.
columns.donor_country: Donor's country, canonicalized so spelling/name variants collapse to one value.
columns.donor_country_raw: Donor country exactly as printed, before canonicalization.
columns.donor_country_iso3: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code for donor_country; null for organizations or unresolved names.
columns.donor_entity_type: "country", "organization" (e.g. UN, EU), "subnational" (city/region rolled up to its parent country), or "unknown".
columns.circumstances: Stated reason the gift was accepted rather than declined.
columns.source_documents: Federal Register document number(s) the gift was reported in, comma-separated. Only populated for records extracted after this field was added.
columns.source_urls: Federal Register notice URL(s) for source_documents, comma-separated.

most_valuable_gifts.sql: select recipient_name, recipient_title, donor_name, donor_country, gift_description, estimated_value, received from gifts where estimated_value is not null order by estimated_value desc limit 50
most_valuable_gifts.title: Most valuable gifts

gifts_by_country.sql: select donor_country, donor_country_iso3, count(*) as gift_count, sum(estimated_value) as total_value from gifts where donor_country is not null group by donor_country order by gift_count desc
gifts_by_country.title: Gifts by donor country

gifts_by_year.sql: select substr(received, 1, 4) as year, count(*) as gift_count, sum(estimated_value) as total_value from gifts where received is not null group by year order by year desc
gifts_by_year.title: Gifts by year

disposition_breakdown.sql: select disposition, count(*) as gift_count from gifts group by disposition order by gift_count desc
disposition_breakdown.title: Gifts by disposition

date_resolved_recipients.sql: select recipient_name, recipient_name_raw, name_and_title, received, gift_description from gifts where recipient_name_source = 'date-resolved' order by received
date_resolved_recipients.title: Recipients resolved from officeholder tenure dates
